[Verse]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
Well my name's John Lee Pettimore[/tab]
Same as my daddy and his daddy before
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
You hardly ever saw Grandaddy down here[/tab]
He only came to town about twice a year
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
He'd buy a hundred pounds of yeast and some copper line[/tab]
Everybody knew that he made moonshine
[tab]           [ch]G[/ch]                  [ch]C[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]

[tab][ch]D[/ch]
He never came back from Copperhead Road[/tab]

[INTRO RIFF]

[Verse]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
Now Daddy ran the whiskey in a big block Dodge[/tab]
Bought it at an auction at the Mason's Lodge
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
Johnson County Sheriff painted on the side[/tab]
Just shot a coat of primer then he looked inside
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
Well him and my uncle tore that engine down[/tab]
I still remember that rumblin' sound
[tab]            [ch]G[/ch]                         [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]
Well the sheriff came around in the middle of the night[/tab]

Heard mama cryin', knew something wasn't right[/tab]

He was headed down to Knoxville with the weekly load[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch] (LET RING)
You could smell the whiskey burnin' down Copperhead Road[/tab]

[tab][ch]D[/ch]
I volunteered for the Army on my birthday[/tab]
They draft the white trash first,'round here anyway
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
I done two tours of duty in Vietnam[/tab]
And I came home with a brand new plan
[tab][ch]D[/ch]
I take the seed from Colombia and Mexico[/tab]
I plant it up the holler down Copperhead Road
[tab]           [ch]G[/ch]              [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]
